admission.justification: The record and its pinned fingerprint live in two files: the JSON record carries the measurements and the test-support module pins its identity, so both must move together.

applicability: The capsule-budget record after a role-text change.
conditions: Only measured sizes and source identities change.
exclusions: Any change to a ceiling or limit, which the developer alone sets.
statement: The capsule-budget record is renewed in measured and identity fields only, with no ceiling and no limit raised.
